rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
# The libraries that only the programs of gettext use, as in Debian: no files # to link against them. FULL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" rm -f "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libgettextlib.so" "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libgettextlib.a" rm -f "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libgettextsrc.so" "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libgettextsrc.a" rm -f "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libtextstyle.so" "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/libtextstyle.a" rm -rf "$FULL_PREFIX/include/textstyle" "$FULL_PREFIX/include/textstyle.h"
